company: Yuwell Medical (Jiangsu Yuyue Medical Equipment & Supply)

last_media_mention: Yuwell Medical Makes Its Debut at CES 2026: AI Expands the Boundaries of Health Management (PR Newswire/PRNasia, Jan 2026). Also covered by TrendHunter, MedTech Spectrum, ZDNET.
notes_flags: FILTER PASS: Public (002223.SZ). $1B+ revenue, market leader in China home medical devices. CES 2026 debut signals aggressive global/US expansion. Wrist BP is part of larger ecosystem play. AI-powered wearable ecosystem. Strategic partnership with Inogen (respiratory). CFA Team China official partner.
